the preparation of amorphous hydrogenated silicon alloy thin films by radio frequency glow discharge and the determination of the thickness and the composition of the deposited films.

the RF sputtering technique is very useful for the fabrication of amorphous silicon thin film solar cells and other devices.

the RF sputtering technique is very useful for the fabrication of amorphous silicon thin film devices.
the composition of the films is independent of deposition conditions and the thickness of films is proportional to the deposition time.
